card.name: Micron filter sizes and asphalt text
card.fires_on: The '-m' piece right after a filter pore size like 0.2 or 0.22, just before 'icron'. Also fires on a few words in engineering text about asphalt and heat-resisting metals.

modes.label: Micron filter size
modes.description: The '-m' that begins 'micron' after a pore size number in infusion filter instructions.
modes.example: Administer LUMIZYME using an in-line low protein binding 0.2<<-m>>icron filter.

modes.description: A linking word or word start in engineering passages on asphalt or metals.
